Town Clerk/Tax Collector 
The Town Clerk/Tax Collector's Office processes motor vehicle and boat registrations, dog licenses,  vital records requests, and property tax billing and payments. We are also your reliable source for all information regarding  elections . 
NEWS
            FROM THE TOWN CLERK’S OFFICE 
Upcoming 2026 Election in Grantham:  General Election & Absentee Ballots 
The   General Election occurs Tuesday, November 3.  The polling place is located in the downstairs room at Grantham Town Hall, located at 300 Route 10 South.  Polls are open 7:00 am until 7:00 pm.  Registered voters should bring a government-issued photo ID to obtain a ballot and vote. Same day voter registration is available as always, though we STRONGLY encourage voters to register prior to election day. Please see the link below for more information regarding the documents required for you to register to vote. 
Also,  Absentee Ballots  for the 2026 General Election are now available! To apply, please complete an  Absentee Ballot Request Form ; you will find it  here . 
Questions? Please contact the
    Town Clerk’s office at 863-5608 or at  [email protected] ov. 
Upcoming Closure in the Town Clerk/Tax Collector's Office-Wednesday, October 7 thru Friday, October 9 
The Grantham Town Clerk/Tax Collector's Office will be  closed ALL DAY  starting  Wednesday, October 7th through Friday, October 9th  so that staff may attend the annual statewide town clerks conference. We will resume normal hours starting Tuesday, October 13th. Please plan ahead to avoid this closure. 
Please note that all other town offices will be open normal hours. 
Kenneth B. Story, Town Clerk/Tax Collector 
Penny Palmer, Deputy Town Clerk/Tax Collector 
(603) 863-5608;  [email protected] 
Regular Office Hours : Monday-Thursday, 8:00 am - 5:00 pm; Friday, 8:00 am - 12:00 pm and 1:00 - 4:00 pm. 
PLEASE NOTE : Given that the town clerk works alone on   Mondays , the office is closed for 15 minutes in mid-afternoon to run errands at the bank and post office. However, the exact time changes from week to week, depending on the volume of counter traffic on any given Monday. If you are needing to get in and out quickly,   PLEASE   call ahead (603-863-5608) to make sure the clerk is present at the time you'll be coming down. 
Please check the   Grantham Municipal Calendar   for changes to our regular hours.
